# Decisions

ADR-style — why things are the way they are.

- [[age-signal-formula-commit-date]] — Age a package by its .rb file's last commit date, never by the bottle's OCI created timestamp
- [[bypass-flag-naming]] — Name the escape hatch --bypass, because --no-quarantine already means Gatekeeper
- [[cache-dates-never-verdicts]] — Cache the date a revision landed, never the pass/fail verdict
- [[gate-wrapper-not-tap-time-travel]] — Implement the cooldown as a plan-filtering gate, not by pinning taps to an old commit
- [[hold-unknown-ages-by-default]] — Hold packages whose age cannot be established, rather than letting them through
- [[ruby-source-path-is-authoritative]] — Take the tap file path from ruby_source_path, do not reconstruct it from the package name
